author: GNiendorf
body:
#### PR description:

This PR makes the pixel CA's Outer Tracker hits on the device, directly from the OT clusters of the modules the CA reads, and removes the host converter `Phase2OTRecHitsSoAConverter` from the Phase-2 HLT menus and the offline `phase2CAExtension` workflow. Outputs are unchanged.

- `Phase2StripCPE`: the cluster position as a constexpr device function; the host CPE is unchanged. A unit test checks it against the topology on every backend.
- `Phase2OTCAHitsAlpaka` with `Phase2OTCAModuleParamsESProducerAlpaka`: copies the clusters of the CA modules (the P sensors of the PS modules in the OT barrel) to the device; one thread per cluster computes the position, errors and global position from the per-module parameters.
- `PixelTrackProducerFromSoAAlpaka` (without `expandVectorHits`) throws unless its OT rechits are made from the clusters of the CA's OT hits, one per cluster; for this, `Phase2OTCAHitsAlpaka` also puts an `edm::RefProd` to its clusters (dictionary in `DataFormats/Phase2TrackerCluster`).
- HLT menus (`HLT_75e33`, `HLT_75e33_timing`, `HLT_NGTScouting`): the CA's OT hits are now `hltPhase2OtCAHitsSoA` (was `hltPhase2OtRecHitsSoA`), with a serial clone in the CPU vs GPU validation sequence. The vector hit CA (`phase2CAVectorHits`, `ngtScouting`) does not read them and is unchanged.
- Offline `phase2CAExtension`: the same module, in a Task so that its ESProducer is built only when scheduled, and a serial clone; `pixelTracksAlpakaSerial` now reads `siPixelRecHitsPreSplittingAlpakaSerial` (`siPixelRecHitsExtendedPreSplittingAlpakaSerial` does not exist).
- `Phase2OTRecHitsSoAConverter` removed; `RecoLocalTracker/Phase2TrackerRecHits` is now built per Alpaka backend.

#### PR validation:

CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-1100 with only this PR:
- Phase-2 HLT on the CPU, 500 ttbar + 500 QCD PU200 events: every TH1/TH2 of the tracking validation identical bin by bin. Plots: [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/internal-prs/ot-rechits-alpaka/ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/internal-prs/ot-rechits-alpaka/qcd/plots_hlt.html)
- On the GPU, the same events: differences within the release's own GPU run-to-run spread.
- HLT timing, ttbar PU200 (16 jobs x 16 threads; NVIDIA L40 for the GPU menu): the OT hits take 1.3 ms per event in the GPU menu and 4.3 ms in the CPU menu, instead of 13 ms for the host converter; throughput and memory unchanged.
title: The CA's Phase-2 OT hits made on the device
